enterprise_model.businesses: end-to-end operating authority within enterprise boundaries
enterprise_model.ess: administrative umbrella for enterprise support functions
enterprise_model.j2: distinct institutional intelligence/judgment/learning capability outside ESS
enterprise_model.internal_audit: independent assurance; functional line to Board Audit & Compliance Committee
enterprise_model.authority_principle: vertical authority; horizontal expertise; shared foundations; dotted lines do not decide

ess.chief_role: administrative head, not super-executive or de facto COO
functions: Office of General Counsel / Corporate Secretary
Continuity/crisis coordination as Corporate Secretary/ESS duty

finance.doctrine: imperial over financial truth, bounded on business judgment

people_and_culture.hybrid_work: work where the work works best
people_and_culture.benefit_friction_rule: never give with one hand and take with the other
performance_questions: Where could you go from here?
people_and_culture.mobility: right to explore; current manager has consultation but no silent veto
people_and_culture.candidate_feedback_rule: meaningful human interaction creates duty of human conclusion/feedback
people_and_culture.ownership_direction: fair cash compensation + profit participation + long-duration broad employee ownership; conservatively structured ESOP or similar trust preferred
people_and_culture.workforce_reduction_principle: reversible levers, redeployment, retraining and leadership sacrifice precede unavoidable RIF

technology_services.operating_principle: standardize the foundation hard; keep the edges soft
technology_services.restriction_burden: IT restrictions on autonomy require a material institutional reason

security.incident_postmortem: blameless by default with accountability for malice or clear recklessness

ai.architecture: tiered local/private + Sable Harbor-hosted + frontier-model capability
ai.agent_delegation: explicit, scoped, narrowing rather than expanding

decision_doctrine.decision_quality_basis: what was reasonably knowable at the time, not outcome alone
decision_doctrine.autonomy_rule: autonomy does not require justification; restrictions do
decision_doctrine.meeting_default: no meeting unless synchronous interaction has a clear purpose/owner

capital_allocation.allocation_basis: durable opportunity rather than history, politics, size, or prior-year spend

rings.name: Issue Rooms
rings.purpose: temporary one-owner problem teams with all material knowledge present

executive_architecture.j2_role: information coherence and uncertainty context, not executive decision ownership

professional_practices.rule: functions own the profession; businesses own the work

business_status_test: permanence such that autonomy improves decisions
acquisition_paths: incubate for learning with explicit intent

deferred: full Sable Harbor Management System (SHMS) doctrine — next priority
Alexandria runtime/entitlements/retention/Semaphore/Daedalus/spatial/business-finance portal implementation until CCF/technology-control architecture
